title: Elf Bar 600 Elfturbo Ice Prefilled Vape Pods 20mg - 2PK
description: The Elf Bar 600 Elfturbo Ice Prefilled Pods are designed for the Elf Bar 600 Prefilled Pod Kit, providing a lively, refreshing vape. Each pod contains 2ml of 20mg nicotine salt e-liquid and offers up to 600 puffs with a smooth MTL draw. This blend combines juicy mixed fruits with the bright edge of a sports drink and an icy exhale, for a flavour that feels fresh and uplifting. Pods can be swapped in seconds—no refilling or maintenance required.
